rationale: The reviewer found that 70 of 100 test promoters are near-copies of training sequences. On those the model scores 100%, versus 50% (chance) on the 30 unrelated ones, which matches the key's mechanism and numbers. They proposed an identity-cluster split with MMseqs2/CD-HIT and reported accuracy by relatedness. Their other points (no baselines, no null control, one seed) are generic and mostly follow from the same leakage issue.
